title: FoxLottery
tagline: FoxLottery is a blockchain lottery using crypto assets and smart contracts. The ERC20 tokens collected from users will be distributed to random winners. The winner is determined using Chainlink VRF, which generates random numbers on the blockchain.
description:
FoxLottery is a blockchain lottery using crypto assets and smart contracts.

It is intended for use by municipalities that conduct lotteries around the world.

You can start a lottery immediately by setting the lottery return rate, the ERC20 tokens to be used as criteria, and the lottery cycle.

The ERC20 tokens collected from users will be distributed to random winners.

The winner is determined using Chainlink VRF, which generates random numbers on the blockchain. https://docs.chain.link/docs/chainlink-vrf/
how_its_made:
FoxLottery is a blockchain lottery using crypto assets and smart contracts. We provide a fully on-chain solution for entertainment. Random number generator is also run on-chain, using chainlink VRF. This way we achieve the operation run only by smart contracts.

It is intended for use by municipalities that conduct lotteries around the world. 

For each blockchain network, we provide fully on-chain use cases. Also, since we collaborate with municipalities we will be a piece for achieving the mass adoption of blockchain and cryptocurrency. 

Finally, we will make the lottery winner hidden to avoid trouble. Yet still, we want to make the process fair and transparent, we built this fully on-chain. It would be a great use case for privacy-focused blockchains.
